studies.question: Does a local LLM improve assertion and account attribution over rules/classical NLP?
studies.claim_boundary: documented assertions/accounts, not actual clinician cognition

studies.question: Does verification reduce material unsupported content while retaining useful coverage?
studies.claim_boundary: measured error detection and support, not guaranteed truth

studies.question: Can the system distinguish before, after and unknown cue availability?
studies.claim_boundary: reviewer-model response to controlled evidence, not historical mental states

studies.question: Are judgments invariant to equivalent risk representations with fixed risks, options and utilities?
studies.claim_boundary: representation/choice behaviour under specified utilities, not human loss-aversion estimates

studies.question: Can a method recover stipulated mechanisms from verified generated narratives?
studies.claim_boundary: within-world recovery; no real clinical causal validity

studies.question: How do trace extraction and uncertainty affect investigation conclusions?
studies.claim_boundary: reconstruction/conformance effects, not automatic error or negligence

studies.question: Does component fine-tuning add incremental value?
Which missing evidence most improves an investigation per unit burden?
studies.claim_boundary: formal VOI requires explicit calibrated study model; otherwise empirical ranking

work_packages.title: Source and dependency admission
work_packages.inputs: Existing corpus/rights register and component datasets
work_packages.planned_deliverable: Immutable candidate manifest, no implicit downloads/releases
work_packages.acceptance: Unknown revision/licence remains explicit; public and controlled subsets separate

work_packages.title: Minimal source-linked record
work_packages.inputs: Existing evidence schema and CA01–CA05
work_packages.planned_deliverable: Versioned assertion/account/time/span record and synthetic fixtures
work_packages.acceptance: Unknown availability and competing accounts survive round-trip; no duplicate generic validator

work_packages.title: Grouped split and mutation lineage
work_packages.inputs: Source family IDs and duplicate/version relationships
work_packages.planned_deliverable: Frozen development/calibration/test grouping manifest
work_packages.acceptance: All linked reports, variants and renders stay in one family; fit vocabulary only on training

work_packages.title: Rules baseline
work_packages.inputs: Admitted spaCy/medspaCy and documented labels
work_packages.planned_deliverable: Thin rules/ConText/section adapter
work_packages.acceptance: Polarity, attribution and offset fixtures; measured per-label errors; raw text untouched

work_packages.title: Classical statistical baseline
work_packages.inputs: Same labelled examples and units
work_packages.planned_deliverable: scikit-learn TF-IDF + regularised linear pipeline
work_packages.acceptance: Grouped validation, class/rare-label metrics and label-budget learning curves

work_packages.title: Optional compact encoder baseline
work_packages.inputs: Admitted local encoder and same labels
work_packages.planned_deliverable: Non-generative encoder adapter
work_packages.acceptance: Separate category from classical NLP; same splits and documented compute/training budget

work_packages.title: Untuned local LLM baseline
work_packages.inputs: Existing runtime/harness and admitted model tuple
work_packages.planned_deliverable: Structured output adapter without weight changes
work_packages.acceptance: Exact prompt/template/context recorded; all failures counted; no cloud data flow

work_packages.title: Exact source verifier
work_packages.inputs: Immutable source bytes, quotes, IDs and offsets
work_packages.planned_deliverable: Deterministic source/span/version/number checker
work_packages.acceptance: Reject injected wrong-ID/span/version/polarity fixtures where detectable; false rejection reported

work_packages.title: Semantic support verifier
work_packages.inputs: Admitted NLI/error datasets and local model
work_packages.planned_deliverable: Calibrated supported/contradicted/insufficient assessor
work_packages.acceptance: Hypothesis-only/shuffled-evidence controls; original and corrected items; no proof-of-truth claim

work_packages.title: Availability and order verifier
work_packages.inputs: Event/document/recipient-availability intervals
work_packages.planned_deliverable: Cutoff entitlement and graph consistency checks
work_packages.acceptance: Before/after/unknown cases distinguished; contradiction preserved; no invented point timestamps

work_packages.title: Mutation manifest and operators
work_packages.inputs: Controlled-experiment definitions
work_packages.planned_deliverable: One-factor edits, invariants and expected affected outputs
work_packages.acceptance: Every change traced; immutable originals; absence of evidence distinct from actual omission

work_packages.title: Outcome × availability experiment
work_packages.inputs: Frozen development-selected method and paired families
work_packages.planned_deliverable: Independent-session 2×3 outcome/availability run ledger
work_packages.acceptance: Outcome invariance and relevant-cue sensitivity scored separately, clustered by family

work_packages.title: Equivalent risk-framing experiment
work_packages.inputs: Fixed risks/denominators/horizons/options/utilities
work_packages.planned_deliverable: Equivalent percentages/frequencies/survival-mortality variants
work_packages.acceptance: Exact arithmetic oracle; representation invariance distinct from action optimality

work_packages.title: Synthetic world and evidence projection
work_packages.inputs: Explicit events, actors, causal assumptions and seeded mechanism
work_packages.planned_deliverable: Hidden world/oracle plus permitted observable packet
work_packages.acceptance: Oracle unavailable to RCA system; alternative compatible explanations accepted where non-identifiable

work_packages.title: Renderer and round-trip controls
work_packages.inputs: Observable packet, template renderer and optional local generator
work_packages.planned_deliverable: Verified narrative variants and renderer metadata
work_packages.acceptance: No mechanism labels; render-to-world audit; held-out generator/style and template-only controls

work_packages.title: Source-to-trace adapter
work_packages.inputs: Rules/LLM records and audited reference traces
work_packages.planned_deliverable: Canonical uncertain trace and optional XES/OCEL2 export
work_packages.acceptance: Source spans and interval/partial-order information preserved; export loss explicit

work_packages.title: Upstream process-engine fixture
work_packages.inputs: Qualified upstream Rust4PM revision
work_packages.planned_deliverable: Thin replay/conformance adapter and consumer fixtures
work_packages.acceptance: Use existing algorithms; reference-model provenance; deviation not labelled clinical error

work_packages.title: Uncertain-conformance comparator spike
work_packages.inputs: Published uncertainty method; optional qualified PROVED/PM4Py
work_packages.planned_deliverable: Replication or explicit unsupported-capability report
work_packages.acceptance: Compatibility/licence recorded; no claim of uncertainty support from ordinary alignments

work_packages.title: Extraction-to-judgment propagation
work_packages.inputs: Reference, rules-derived and LLM-derived traces
work_packages.planned_deliverable: Paired assessment comparison with fixed downstream model
work_packages.acceptance: Attribute changed judgments to trace differences; include matching-context raw-text comparator

work_packages.title: Patient-concern and omission audit
work_packages.inputs: Documented concern inventory and permitted context
work_packages.planned_deliverable: Concern-to-response trace and material omission score
work_packages.acceptance: Missing voice stated; no inferred preferences; precision and useful coverage reported jointly

work_packages.title: Generator-plus-verifier evaluation
work_packages.inputs: Natural model errors and separate injected-error set
work_packages.planned_deliverable: End-to-end quality/coverage/resource report
work_packages.acceptance: Verifier gains, misses and false blocking measured; no all-abstain winner

work_packages.title: Paired analysis and pilot precision
work_packages.inputs: Frozen contrast, case-family run ledger and rubric
work_packages.planned_deliverable: Cluster-aware estimates, uncertainty and cost-consequence table
work_packages.acceptance: Variants/repeats not independent cases; numerical margins set before test unblinding

work_packages.title: Conditional adaptation decision
work_packages.inputs: Repeated residual errors and authorised training labels
work_packages.planned_deliverable: One bounded train/no-train decision and optional PEFT contrast
work_packages.acceptance: Beats strongest untuned comparator under predeclared gates or retains untuned model

work_packages.title: Optional value-of-evidence model
work_packages.inputs: Explicit states, priors, likelihoods, utilities and acquisition cost
work_packages.planned_deliverable: Voiage consumer experiment or empirical question-ranking study
work_packages.acceptance: Compare supported accuracy or material-error/decision-loss reduction at a fixed evidence budget; report burden separately; formal VOI requires an admitted explicit study model

work_packages.title: Coherent paper and handoff
work_packages.inputs: Verified results, primary citations and negative findings
work_packages.planned_deliverable: Research report in learningfromharm and reproducibility bundle
work_packages.acceptance: Claims match source/task/hardware evidence; clinical/education benefit unclaimed without observations

synthetic_availability_fixtures.scope: simple specified interval/cutoff fixtures; no mechanistic world or LLM renderer required

synthetic_risk_fixtures.scope: fixed numerical risk/utility fixtures; no mechanistic world or LLM renderer required
